Batch 3 — independent candidate review

25 reviewed: 13 candidates with limitations; 12 needs-user-review. No final approvals, art edits or release authorization. Illustrations are not actual-model screenshots.

All 50 fresh offline desktop/mobile cases and 25 motion suites passed. Archive selected payloads match exactly; Paraguay full historical inventory remains unchecked. Hinge clarity is not proved mechanical failure. No fresh Blender/collision or fallback revalidation.

algeria — needs-user-review

Warmer streaked wood and more faceted towers; exact spacing/proportions cannot be measured from differing cameras. Hold retained; attachment not proven detached.

australia — needs-user-review

Five domes retained; more regular strata but also visible faceting. More regular/less naturally sculpted is better supported than uniformly smoother. Hold retained.

belgium — needs-user-review

Dense speckling and angular branching relief weaken individual fossil-ring readability; hold retained.

brunei — needs-user-review

Saturated burgundy and repetitive diamonds versus muted tactile mauve/plum. Feet and finger-jointed corners occur in both, not new defects. Hold retained.

central-african-republic — needs-user-review

Simplified foliage and clearing/water detail; pond poorly resolved, not proven absent. Hold retained.

croatia — needs-user-review

Three pools and spillways retained. Marketing itself also has smooth stone and simplified water; differences modest. Preserve parent hinge-clarity hold, not proven detached.

dr-congo — candidate-with-limitations

Canopy/river identity retained; original images confirm side ring and feet. Fuller marketing foliage and bolder diamonds are disclosed finish differences.

ethiopia — candidate-with-limitations

Three plateau arrangement retained; faceted cliffs and repetitive stone underside remain disclosed finish limitations.

ghana — needs-user-review

Marketing handle is a low-profile rectangular loop, not tall upright hardware. Viewer has a shallow brass rectangular feature but opening/relief unresolved. Retain handle-fidelity hold; missing geometry not proven.

honduras — candidate-with-limitations

Two tree clusters, terrain and river retained; dark forest-green lid versus sage/mint marketing and angular foliage disclosed.

ireland — needs-user-review

Smaller tidier paving, broad cream waves and less substantial ring remain substantive fidelity hold.

kiribati — candidate-with-limitations

Interrupted near shore and lifted/sloping segment confirmed; not broken geometry. Weave and vegetation simplified.

libya — candidate-with-limitations

Arch aperture and pale inset retained. Saturated ochre and angular striations disclosed. Hidden arch in open pose is not disappearance.

mali — candidate-with-limitations

Three formations retained; harder stacked ledges and golden mottling versus muted softer rendering. Summit dimensions not certified.

monaco — needs-user-review

More tightly clustered village on lower regular shelf. Both views expose water; hold concerns relative footprint and cliff sculpting, not missing land/buildings.

nepal — candidate-with-limitations

Three separate snowcapped peaks retained, not a missing connected range. Brighter snow and graphic bands disclosed.

norway — candidate-with-limitations

Two masses and fjord retained; flat cyan water, faceted slopes and repetitive bands disclosed.

paraguay — candidate-with-limitations

Five radial rosettes and hardware retained; brighter pink/stronger bands and noisy mobile lace. Full historical inventory unchecked hold retained.

russia — candidate-with-limitations

Six ice forms and fractures retained. Marketing also stylized/opaque, so lack of transparency alone not a fidelity defect.

saudi-arabia — candidate-with-limitations

Three asymmetric tiered formations retained. Marketing also somewhat carved/wood-like; regular strata disclosed. Focused second review did not substantiate floating-hardware allegation.

solomon-islands — needs-user-review

Subdued charcoal gray marketing versus warm reddish-brown body/tan lid, repetitive grain and flat inlays. Substantive hold retained.

sudan — candidate-with-limitations

Three pyramids retained; broad bright ochre mottling and faceting versus finer muted finish disclosed.

the-moon — candidate-with-limitations

Three crater forms and highlands retained; smoother rims, cloudy pale surface and simpler metal disclosed.

tuvalu — needs-user-review

Compact low faceted enclosing platform differs from broader irregular sandbank; stronger turquoise oval and regular weave. Substantive hold retained.

vanuatu — needs-user-review

Recessed volcano retained; flat pale orange-yellow ember versus patterned molten material and coarser ash. Substantive hold retained.
